about.label: About
about.title: Engineer and founder.
about.subtitle: From a first line of Scratch in 2017 to products with real customers.
about.p1: I got my first computer at eight and spent hours trying to understand how things worked. Curiosity turned into a passion for technology.
about.p2: At school I learned logic with Scratch and wrote my first “Hello World” in Python in 2017. In my last year of high school I decided Computer Science would be my path.
about.p3: Since then I've built for the web, mobile, backend, smart contracts and on-device AI, working at BTG Pactual and Parfin along the way. Today I work as a harness engineer and build my own businesses.
